verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Manufact deploys MCP servers from user-owned GitHub repos and offers an API/CLI for programmatic access (manufact-docs-16, manufact-docs-17, manufact-probe-4), but there is no documentation of an explicit 'export all your data' feature covering logs, observability payloads, deployment history, or test results in open/portable formats, nor any account-closure data-export workflow.
